thought.text: The RLS policy is now in place. The worker should now be able to claim jobs. Let me re-probe readiness.

reasoning_content: The RLS policy has been created. The worker was running (claim_failed was retrying). Let's wait and check whether the worker becomes ready now. The worker pool was started when the app started, and it's claiming tasks. Now that the policy is in place, the claims should succeed. Let's poll the readiness check.

action.command: sleep 12; echo "=== /health/ready summary ==="; curl -s --max-time 10 http://localhost:3000/health/ready | node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c).on('end',()=>{const j=JSON.parse(d);console.log('status=',j.status);console.log('db=',j.checks.db,'redis=',j.checks.redis,'keycloak=',j.checks.keycloak);console.log('jobWorker=',j.checks.services?.jobWorker?.status);console.log('errs=',JSON.stringify(j.checks.errors));console.log('tenantLogin=',JSON.stringify(j.checks.checks?.tenantLoginContract??j.checks.tenantLoginContract??'n/a'));})"; echo "=== worker log tail ==="; grep -iE 'worker' /tmp/app-serve2.log | tail -4

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "sleep 12; echo \"=== /health/ready summary ===\"; curl -s --max-time 10 http://localhost:3000/health/ready | node -e \"let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c).on('end',()=>{const j=JSON.parse(d);console.log('status=',j.status);console.log('db=',j.checks.db,'redis=',j.checks.redis,'keycloak=',j.checks.keycloak);console.log('jobWorker=',j.checks.services?.jobWorker?.status);console.log('errs=',JSON.stringify(j.checks.errors));console.log('tenantLogin=',JSON.stringify(j.checks.checks?.tenantLoginContract??j.checks.tenantLoginContract??'n/a'));})\"; echo \"=== worker log tail ===\"; grep -iE 'worker' /tmp/app-serve2.log | tail -4", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Re-probe readiness after RLS fix"}
